title: Influence after applying the noise operator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0\leq\rho\leq1$. The influence of coordinate $i$ on the noise-operator image of $f$ is at most $\sum_{S\ni i}\rho^{|S|-1}\widehat f(S)^2$, where the sum ranges over subsets of the coordinate set.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on the n-dimensional cube
Coordinate i among the n coordinates
